# Sound Effects

Sound effects generator: describe a whoosh, footsteps, rain ambience, foley or a UI click and get the SFX file generated in seconds, for videos, games, apps and podcasts.

## What it does
Describe the sound and its length. Claude tells you the price and creates it in your account.

**How the files are made:** each sound effect is generated by an audio model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

From 1 to 22 seconds per effect.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install sound-effects@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Sound Effects talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/sound-effects/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each sound effect uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The sound effect plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_sound_models` | Models for sound effects with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_sound_cost` | Exact price of one sound effect before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_sound` | Starts one sound effect in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_sound` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Heavy rain on a tin roof, 15 seconds, loopable"
- "A sci-fi door opening with a hiss"
- "Soft UI click for a mobile app button"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the sound effect (the description and the length) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
